_comment: TEST DATA ONLY, for Phase 2 'four phones can play a desk race' (doc §13), extended in Phase 4/5 with one real photo checkpoint. Checkpoints 1-5 are self-checked (trivia/observation/puzzle/navigation/qr); checkpoint 6 is AI-judged and needs Phase 4/5's capture+upload+judging, now built. Not tied to real GPS coordinates or real Barcelona locations - all radiusMeters: 0. Time caps are shortened from the doc's 8-minute default so the skip flow can be exercised in a short desk test.

checkpoints.name: Desk checkpoint 1
checkpoints.instruction: What is the capital of Catalonia?

checkpoints.name: Desk checkpoint 2
checkpoints.clue: Look around the room you are sitting in.
checkpoints.instruction: How many legs does a standard table have?

checkpoints.name: Desk checkpoint 4
checkpoints.instruction: This is checkpoint 4 of 5. Which checkpoint number comes next?

checkpoints.name: Desk checkpoint 6 (photo)
checkpoints.instruction: Photograph a coffee cup or mug.
